foils.code:
def transform(grid):
    a=[r[:] for r in grid]; H=len(a); W=len(a[0]); bg=0
    cells=[(i,j,a[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if a[i][j]!=bg]
    from collections import Counter
    cs=Counter(v for _,_,v in cells)
    if len(cs)!=2:return a
    linecol=max(cs,key=cs.get); other=[v for v in cs if v!=linecol][0]
    line=[(i,j) for i,j,v in cells if v==linecol]
    obj=[(i,j) for i,j,v in cells if v==other]
    if len(obj)!=4:return a
    rs={i for i,j in obj}; c={j for i,j in obj}
    if len(rs)!=2 or len(c)!=2:return a
    for i,j in obj:a[i][j]=0
    lr=next(iter({i for i,j in line})); top=min(rs); left=min(c)
    nt=lr+1 if top>lr else lr-2
    for i in range(nt,nt+2):
        for j in range(left,left+2): a[i][j]=other
    return a

foils.code:
def transform(grid):
    a=[r[:] for r in grid]; H=len(a); W=len(a[0])
    lines=[i for i in range(H) if len(set(a[i]))==1 and a[i][0]!=0]
    if not lines:return a
    r=lines[0]; pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if a[i][j]!=0 and i not in lines]
    if not pts:return a
    col=a[pts[0][0]][pts[0][1]]; rs={i for i,j in pts}; cs={j for i,j in pts}; top=min(rs)
    for i,j in pts:a[i][j]=0
    shift=(r+1-top) if top>r else (r-len(rs)-top)
    for i,j in pts:a[i+shift][j]=col
    return a
